newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HOIUPANK SAYS TO SET UP RESERVE FUND.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HOIUPANK SAYS TO SET UP RESERVE FUND.

text.p: Estonia's Hoiupank said on Wednesday that its board has decided to set up a reserve fund in case of the economy overheating followed by a recession.
"Last week the management board of the bank decided to set up a reserve fund in case the economy overheats and a recession starts," Hoiupank's chairman Olari Taal told Reuters in an interview.
No further details about the fund were available yet.
Taal said Hoiupank was taking into account the danger that overheating could happen in Estonia.
"Somehow Estonia has been very lucky because people have been talking about overheating for the last three years and nothing has happened," he said.
Taal said the inflow of foreign money into Estonia was being counterbalanced to some extent by Estonia funds being invested in the other Baltic countries.
"This is spreading the risk of overheating," Taal said.
